audit.quote_check: confirmed in the copy we hold
audit.reasoning: The classification (fixed penultimate primary stress with leftward alternating secondary stress, stress placement coded per word length as 10 010 1010 01010 (1 = a stressed syllable)) rests on the standard reference grammar, Ezard 1997 PL C-137 section 4.5, which we hold with a clean text layer; every quoted fragment was confirmed verbatim on printed pp.44-45 (PDF pp.60-61). The secondary-stress rule in the grammar ('first of every two syllables prior to the primary-stressed syllable, counting leftward') matches the coded rule string (e.g. 5 syllables -> 01010). Glottolog's bibliography offers nothing better: all descriptive works are Ezard's, and the 1997 volume is the published form of the 1990/91 dissertation that StressTyp2 cites.
